stock.description: Hao Tian International Construction Investment Group Limited operates as an investment holding firm with a varied business portfolio. The company is actively involved in the construction sector across Hong Kong, Cambodia, and Macau. Its core activities include the leasing of heavy construction equipment such as crawler cranes, aerial platforms, mobile cranes, and specialist foundation machinery. Furthermore, it engages in the sales and distribution of construction materials and spare parts, alongside providing comprehensive repair and upkeep services for its machinery. The group also offers an array of transportation services, including local container delivery, on-site construction logistics, and the movement of heavy machinery. Property development is another significant area of its involvement. Beyond construction, Hao Tian International diversifies into financial services, offering asset management, brokerage for commodities, futures, and securities, as well as various lending solutions like mortgages, personal loans, and margin financing. It also manages group administration services. Its primary clientele consists of construction enterprises. The company, which commenced operations in 1962, is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. It was formerly known as Clear Lift Holdings Limited until its name change in May 2017, and it operates as a subsidiary of Hao Tian Management (China) Limited.
